text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... And there's the last lap. I believe we've finished everything we had planned for today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's finally summer camp! Yaeno is in high
spirits and powers through
our training
schedule for the day in no time.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Now then,
I'll get straight to goofing off!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Goofing off, as I was meant to accomplish at the amusement park. I give you my word— I will forget about training during my downtime!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Especially...
since there's something I want
to check...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...No,
I was just mumbling to myself! I'll let
you know when I have a
better grasp of it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Amateur though I am, I will attempt a
gleeful romp down the shore.
I'll give my
full concentration to splashing in the
waves!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I just finished a game with the tide!
I tried to zigzag along the water's
edge without
touching it, learning much about
route-planning for—oh. I inadvertently
trained again...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I went and played beach volleyball! I
learned to read my opponents' body
language and how they channel power into
pinpoint spikes,
which is sure to be useful for... Ah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Yet again, I've failed to forget my
training.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
This time...
I went for a mindless run down
the beach and back! Does
that... still count
as training?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Tch, then I'll just keep trying!
I'm going to the festival this evening! If
you can spare
the time, I would appreciate the company,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The waves of people are fierce as a
storm-swept sea. Finding a way through
this crowd will serve as good practice for
breaking past the
pack... No!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Tch, even the festival cannot tear my mind
from racing?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Good choice. Shooting targets shouldn't
be relevant to racing...
Right? This may be
just the activity I need for a
breakthrough.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I thank you for your guidance, Trainer.

Pardon, Sir! I would like to purchase a
ticket for the shooting game!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pop!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pop! Pop!

text_block_list.name: Festival Worker
text_block_list.text:
Too bad!
You didn't hit anything this time,
kiddo. Better luck next
time!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To miss every shot...
My lack of precision is
humiliating.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's allowed to make mistakes—that's
how people grow. I'm trying to
encourage
her to take things easier, both in and out
of training.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. Somehow, I knew you'd say that.
First at the theme park, and
again now.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
I think I've finally gathered my
resolve. Trainer, would you
give me a little
more of your time?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I mean, of course. I nod my head without
thinking.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Pardon, sir! I would like to purchase five
more tickets for the game!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Aaand she's gonna be at this until she
shoots something.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Urgh, what amateur shooting! To make this
many attempts and still
fail—it's almost
laughable!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, I'm not throwing in the towel yet!
I'm starting to get a feel for
it. I have to be
slow with the aim,
and line it up just right...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, how is my form? Everything look
okay?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the support! Now I just have
to hold the gun gently. Easy
now... Have
fun...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And shoot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pop!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a soft thump, the cat plush Yaeno's
been aiming at is knocked
off its stand.

text_block_list.name: Festival Worker
text_block_list.text:
Bull's-eye! The prize is all yours! Nice
shootin' there, kiddo!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Oh... Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I really did it!
I let completely loose and
had fun playing the game!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way back, as we near the lodge,
Yaeno stops me, saying she
wants to talk
about something.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
At the festival,
I felt like a little kid again.
Playing with a toy gun,
trying to win a
stuffed animal...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes, I did!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...And I finally understood why it took so
long. Why I struggle to stop
training in
times of rest.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I was afraid of the blaze in my heart,
ashamed of letting it show
outside races.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Deep down, I thought unrestrained,
childlike play... was a shameful
mark of
immaturity.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And so I practiced self-restraint and hid
all
my idle desires. I tried to
think only of
training.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
But you taught me that it's okay to fool
around and make mistakes.
And that's
why... That's why I was able to let go and
have fun today.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Because you showed me that I don't have
to fear the blaze. And
that... it's nothing to
be ashamed of.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Right. I understand now.
I can forget about
training when I'm with
you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
With that said, Trainer,
I... I'd like to do
some katas for you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...For some reason, I feel that today's
revelations will give me new
strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I nod, and just as she begins, a firework
bursts in the sky behind her.
The summer
festival must be drawing to a close.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Framed by sparks of light, Yaeno strikes
and dodges with a new

energy—performing the capricious dance
of a flame.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
What a wonder. What a joy this day has
been!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...It's perfect. After a time,
Yaeno's blaze simmers down to a warm
crackle, and we
close out the clear summer evening on a
lighthearted note.
